# Ozeonix Infinity

> Shape Thought. Power Tomorrow.
> Ozeonix Infinity is a modern technology studio and digital solutions company that transforms business ideas into scalable, production-grade digital products. We build custom CRM, ERP, LMS platforms, high-performance web applications, Flutter mobile apps, AI-powered solutions, and enterprise software for clients globally.

## Company Information
- **Official Name**: Ozeonix Infinity
- **Website**: https://ozeonix.com
- **Slogan**: "Shape Thought. Power Tomorrow."
- **Primary Focus**: Custom Software Engineering, ERP/CRM/LMS Development, Flutter Mobile Apps, UI/UX Design, and Cloud Architecture.
- **Operating Model**: Remote-First Global Engineering Team with operations centered in South Asia (Nepal) serving clients internationally.
- **Contact**: info@ozeonix.com | careers@ozeonix.com
- **WhatsApp / Phone**: +977-9769294624
- **Office Location**: Opposite Gyankoop School, 13 Ward, Janakpur, Madhesh Province 45600, Nepal

## Core Services & Capabilities

- [/services](https://ozeonix.com/services): Overview of all engineering services, technical capabilities, and engagement models.
- [/services/erp-development](https://ozeonix.com/services/erp-development): Custom ERP software engineering for schools, manufacturing, retail, and supply chain operations.
- [/services/crm-solutions](https://ozeonix.com/services/crm-solutions): Custom CRM platforms, automated lead routing, pipeline analytics, and omni-channel customer communication.
- [/services/lms-platforms](https://ozeonix.com/services/lms-platforms): Learning Management Systems for schools, colleges, tutoring academies, and corporate workforce training.

---

## Ready-to-Deploy Product Suites

- [/products](https://ozeonix.com/products): Modular, customizable software suites for rapid enterprise deployment:
  - **CampusFlow ERP**: Complete school and campus management (admissions, attendance, gradebooks, exam automation, fee collection).
  - **OmniCommerce Suite**: Multi-vendor, high-conversion headless e-commerce platforms.
  - **LeadPulse CRM**: High-velocity sales pipeline, automated client tracking, and revenue forecasting.
  - **MedPulse Core**: HIPAA-compliant clinic appointments, patient management, and telehealth workflows.
  - **FlowDesk**: Multi-channel customer support ticketing and SLA tracking.
  - **Ozeonix AI Studio**: Custom generative AI integrations, internal document search, and intelligent business workflows.

## Tailored Industry Solutions

- [/industries](https://ozeonix.com/industries): Domain-tailored software engineering across 9 critical sectors:
  - [/industries/e-commerce](https://ozeonix.com/industries/e-commerce): Modern digital storefronts, checkout optimization, and automated inventory sync.
  - [/industries/on-demand](https://ozeonix.com/industries/on-demand): Dispatch algorithms, live GPS routing, and instant booking applications.
  - [/industries/fitness](https://ozeonix.com/industries/fitness): Gym management, workout trackers, trainer booking, and subscription billing.
  - [/industries/payments](https://ozeonix.com/industries/payments): Secure payment gateways, automated invoicing, eSewa/Khalti integrations, and PCI-compliant systems.
  - [/industries/entertainment](https://ozeonix.com/industries/entertainment): Media streaming platforms, creator monetisation, and interactive content portals.
  - [/industries/education](https://ozeonix.com/industries/education): Digital campuses, interactive classrooms, student information systems, and fee portals.
  - [/industries/event](https://ozeonix.com/industries/event): Digital ticketing, QR attendee check-in, seat booking, and conference scheduling.
  - [/industries/restaurant](https://ozeonix.com/industries/restaurant): Cloud POS systems, QR table ordering, kitchen display systems, and menu inventory.
  - [/industries/health](https://ozeonix.com/industries/health): Telemedicine consultations, electronic medical records (EMR), and diagnostic lab portals.

## Careers & Culture

- [/careers](https://ozeonix.com/careers): Remote-first engineering and design careers.
  - **Culture**: High autonomy, direct client impact, modern stack, respect for focus, and continuous learning.
  - **Perks**: Flexible remote hours, hardware stipend, paid time off, and continuous education allowances.
  - **Active Openings**:
    - Frontend Engineer (React 19 / TypeScript / TanStack Router)
    - Mobile Application Developer (Flutter / Dart)
    - Full-Stack Backend Engineer (Node.js / PostgreSQL / Supabase)
    - UI/UX Product Designer (Figma / Design Tokens / WCAG Accessibility)
  - **How to Apply**: Email resume and portfolio to careers@ozeonix.com with role title in subject.

## Technology Stack & Engineering Standards
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript 5.8, TanStack Start (SSR), TanStack Router, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS v4.
- **Mobile**: Flutter, Dart (iOS & Android native parity).
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Cloudflare R2 / AWS, Docker.
- **Design & Quality**: Systematic Design Tokens, WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility, 60fps animation performance, Lighthouse >90 targets.
